name: techapp
description: TechApp — mobile app, admin panel and Supabase backend

scripts.verify: npm run db:test && npm --prefix apps/mobile run verify && npm --prefix apps/admin run typecheck && npm --prefix apps/web run typecheck
scripts.db:types: supabase gen types typescript --linked --schema public > /tmp/techapp-db-types.ts && mv /tmp/techapp-db-types.ts apps/mobile/src/lib/database.generated.ts
scripts.db:types:check: npm run db:types && git diff --exit-code apps/mobile/src/lib/database.generated.ts
scripts.db:push: supabase db push --dry-run && echo 'Review the plan above, then run: npx supabase db push'
scripts.functions:deploy: supabase functions deploy guardian-dispatch && supabase functions deploy delete-account
